title: Lead run statistics with matched before/after classifier metrics

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented primary before/after Accuracy, Precision, Recall cards with pp changes and matched-sample scope. Explicit endpoint audit used 36 decision requests, zero optimizer calls, same protected 18 items (2 include, 16 exclude), no operational trace or labels changed. Accuracy 33.3% to 88.9%; precision 8.3% to 50%; recall 50% to 100%, small positive-count uncertainty displayed. Browser verified on localhost; 516 Python tests and 7 UI tests passed.
